note: NECO Commerce round 6 (R30 top-up): alphabetical, numerical, chronological and subject filing; inward mail register, franking, remittance letter; open-plan vs closed office; personnel department; requisition; index card; cross-reference; hawker, pedlar, cheap jack, stallholder and their common feature; five Cs of credit (capacity, collateral, character, capital, condition); air for perishables, sea for heavy cargo, road door-to-door, rail for cement, pipeline for gas; telex, fax, telegram, email vs post, telephone's no-record limit. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Commerce (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
